LESSON: ALGEBRAIC EXPRESSIONS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Algebra
Topic 2.1: Algebraic Expressions

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Algebraic Expressions. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. form algebraic expressions from real-life situations
2. form algebraic expressions from simple algebraic statements in real-life situations
3. appreciate the use of algebraic expressions in real-life

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: ALGEBRAIC EXPRESSIONS
Algebraic Expressions is a Grade mathematics skill used at school, at the market, and at home.

HOW TO STUDY THIS TOPIC
1. Read each idea slowly.
2. Copy every worked example into your book and recalculate it yourself.
3. Then try the practice questions without looking at the answers.

WORKED EXAMPLE STYLE
Write the question clearly. Show each step. Box the final answer.
Example framework:
  Question: (write a Algebraic Expressions problem)
  Step 1: …
  Step 2: …
  Answer: …

KENYAN CONTEXT
Use shillings, market goods, school desks, or garden plots as story numbers so the maths feels real.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Solve one simple Algebraic Expressions question using objects or a drawing.

Example 2: Solve a harder Algebraic Expressions question showing every step.

Example 3: Make a word problem about Algebraic Expressions set at a Kenyan market.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write and solve five questions on Algebraic Expressions.
2. Explain one solution aloud to a parent or friend.
3. Invent one new word problem and solve it.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Complete 10 practice questions on Algebraic Expressions in your exercise book.
2. Mark your work. Redo any question you missed.
3. Teach a younger learner one method from this lesson.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. form algebraic expressions from real-life situations
2. form algebraic expressions from simple algebraic statements in real-life situations
3. appreciate the use of algebraic expressions in real-life

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
